description: Use when an agent checks whether a wrapped or backed token's reported reserves cover its supply. Input: optional asset (WBTC, cbBTC, TUSD, stETH, eETH). Output: JSON per asset Chainlink Proof of Reserve value, totalSupply by chain, ratio, reserves minus supply, below-supply flag, supply coverage (full/partial), feed age vs heartbeat, stale flag, feed page. Reported reserves, not an audit. Example: ?asset=WBTC Price: $0.003 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.
name: proof_of_reserve
title: Proof of reserve: Chainlink PoR feeds vs onchain supply for WBTC, cbBTC, TUSD, stETH, eETH, with staleness
